text.tspan: Amazon ECR: private and public registry for container images
• Store and manage Docker images on AWS
• Private and public repositories (ECR Public Gallery)
• Fully integrated with ECS, backed by Amazon S3
• Access controlled through IAM (permission error → policy)
• Image vulnerability scanning, versioning, tags, lifecycle
• Scanning: BASIC (OS CVEs, manual or on push) or
• Lifecycle policies expire old / untagged images
• Pull through cache for upstream registries (Docker Hub...)
• "Private Docker registry on AWS, IAM controlled" → ECR. "Pull fails with AccessDenied" → IAM policy (task execution role on Fargate,
instance role on EC2) or the repository policy for cross-account.
• "Find vulnerabilities in images" → ECR scanning (enhanced = Amazon Inspector, continuous).
• "Too many old images / storage cost" → lifecycle policy. "Same image in another Region / account" → replication.
• "Docker Hub rate limits" → ECR pull through cache.
